text:
alex: Nightly e2e gate is red — p99 for long-seq test jumped ~22% on the 02:00 run. job: nightly-e2e/long-seq (id: 2026-03-17T02:00:00)

maria-ng: ack. seeing the smoke in the dashboard. link: https://perf.redwood.internal/dash/long-seq/nightly/1876543200 (p95 stable, p99 spike) :eyes:

jamal_k: any recent infra changes? autoscaler, batcher, or quant scheduling?

nisha: I rolled a small change to the batcher last night (PR 2146) that touched batch window heuristics. scheduled at 00:45 UTC. might be related.

alex: good catch @nisha. can someone fetch the CI run logs & kvcache profiles for that job?

ci-bot: Fetch complete. artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/nightly-e2e/1876543200/{perf.json,kvcache.log,runner.log}

maria-ng: quick log snippet shows more small requests being batched together causing longer wait for long-seq flows:
```
2026-03-17T02:00:12Z INFO batcher: window_open_ms=12 window_size=48 avg_wait_ms=8
2026-03-17T02:00:12Z WARN solver: schedule_delay_ms=14 active_batches=4
```

jamal_k: I can run a bisect over commits touching the batcher heuristics tomorrow morning. anyone else want to triage first?

nisha: please do the bisect, thanks. test owner ping @maria-ng — if bisect points to the PR I rolled, I'll revert immediately.

alex: before a revert, can we rerun the nightly job on the same config to see if the spike reproduces? if it's flaky we may avoid churn. @ci-bot can you rerun job id 1876543200 as a one-off?

ci-bot: Rerun requested: nightly-e2e/long-seq rerun (parent id 1876543200). new run id: 1876543288. Queued on runner-7.

sre-bot: Noted — holding autoscaler deploys until triage completes. (blocking label applied)

maria-ng: Thanks. If rerun reproduces, jamal, please start a bisect using this command: `tools/e2e_bisect --test long-seq --since=2026-03-16T22:00:00Z --until=2026-03-17T02:00:00Z --worker=runner-7`

jamal_k: Will run that at 09:00 PT and share candidate culprit commits. I’ll also capture a heatmap of sequence lengths vs latency to confirm it's batching-related.

alex: Perfect. Add a short note to the incident board with run ids and PR pointer so PMs know we're on it. (incident: https://incident.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0317-longseq)

nisha: If bisect confirms my PR, I'll open a revert + smaller follow-up to adjust windowing thresholds.

maria-ng: Quick QA note — fallback model variant is enabled for customer-facing routes; still good to communicate risk to support if this persists.

alex: Thanks all. we'll reconvene on this thread with bisect results. :thumbsup:
